The '''Zone of Sullust''' was a region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that contained the [[Forest/Legends|Forest]] [[Moon/Legends|Moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="ST">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] {{C|Paris and Tokyo only}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Zone of Sullust was first mentioned on a galactic map that could be seen in the queues of the [[Disneyland Paris]] and [[Tokyo Disneyland]] [[Star Tours (real-world)|Star Tours]] attractions.<ref name="ST" />

*[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] {{1stm}} {{C|Paris and Tokyo only}}
